programs.title: China, Race to the Future Ep.1
Time travel in Shunde: From ancient ancestral halls to dim sum
programs.desc: Two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia embarked on a journey to the historic Yang'e Village in Shunde, Guangdong Province. There, they savored authentic morning tea, visited ancient ancestral halls to appreciate the architectural grace and clan heritage of Lingnan, and experienced intangible cultural heritage to the rhythm of lion dance drums.

Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
Jing County: A Living Painting
programs.desc: This episode visits Jingxian, Anhui. From the area's convoluted traditional paper and pen production, to the tender leaves of the Spring tea harvest, the presenter takes us beyond the picture-perfect watercolor scenery, to find the rhythm of life in southern Anhui. At the village of Zhaji, she tucks into the famed 12-bowl feast.

Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan
Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programs.desc: In 2022, a video game inspired by Pak Mei kung fu became an online sensation. Continuing his exploration of Foshan, host Kleber meets with a true master of Pak Mei to learn more of the history of martial arts, as well as its connections to food, family and community.

programs.title: China IRL: Beijing Hutongs
programs.desc: Jack, Alex and Tianran wander Beijing's historic laneways, taking in traditional sweets, historical views, and a centuries-old kite-making tradition. Reflecting on the coexistence of ancient customs and hyper-modern life, they climb Beihai Park's iconic white stupa to enjoy an "emperor's view" below.

programs.title: China, Race to the Future Ep.2
programs.desc: This five-episode series explores China's growing cultural confidence, showing how a revival of traditional culture is fueling "chain reactions" that are reshaping Chinese manufacturing and development. In particular, the series stresses how China’s immense cultural capital is empowering a uniquely Chinese approach to building a future that puts openness, globalization and the environment center-stage!

programs.title: A Bite of Xinjiang Ep.2
programs.desc: This is a documentary that comprehensively showcases Xinjiang in all its diversity. Exploring cuisine, landscapes, and folk culture, it shows how diverse ethnic groups drive economic growth, social stability, cultural prosperity, and national unity through diligence and wisdom.

programs.title: China's Green Revolution Ep.2
programs.desc: China's ecological civilization and achievements are celebrated through stories of green development, like the Saihanba and Kubuqi restoration projects.
